subject: DeltaSoft POC charter, acceptance gates, and role allocation
messages:
From: Claire Nguyen <claire@deltasoft.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@deltasoft.com
Date: 2027-09-05T17:45:00-04:00
Subject: Thanks — follow-ups from today

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough earlier — gave our team a clear sense of how Redwood could fit into our search enrichment flow. A few quick asks so we can prep internally for a POC: 

- Can you send a concise POC charter with proposed success criteria (both technical and business)?
- Suggested timeline and checkpoints for a 2–3 week evaluation.
- A compact RACI: who on Redwood owns infra support, who owns embedding/response quality, and who handles security/procurement coordination.

We'd like to surface this to our infra/security and procurement leads tomorrow.

Best,
Claire
Claire Nguyen
Director, Data Products | DeltaSoft
---
From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
To: Claire Nguyen <claire@deltasoft.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-06T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Thanks — follow-ups from today

Claire — great speaking with you. Per our call, below is the proposed POC charter and RACI at a glance. I kept it condensed so you can share with infra/security/procurement. Happy to iterate.

POC objective:
- Prove Redwood inference can serve DeltaSoft search enrichment with target latency and accuracy under representative traffic.

Success criteria (must / stretch):
- Must: p95 generation latency < 200ms on 1k token window for standard queries (measured over 24h of peak-like traffic).
- Must: embedding similarity recall >= 92% vs. your current baseline on the provided eval set.
- Must: no PII leakage on sample prompts (pass security review checklist).
- Stretch: average cost < $0.80 per 1k tokens at trial throughput.

Evaluation plan (3-week cadence recommended):
- Week 0 (onboarding, day 0–3): infra connectivity, API keys, VPC peering (if needed), sample dataset ingest. Kickoff + smoke tests.
- Week 1 (baseline run): steady-state traffic replay with small dataset; collect latency, token counts, and embedding recall.
- Week 2 (stress & edge cases): workload bursts, long sequence prompts, quantization tests, and security probe run.
- Final 48h: acceptance run against agreed prompts & metrics, sign-off if must-criteria met.

RACI (high level) — delta indicates owner / contact: 
- Infra (network, VPC, firewall rules): DeltaSoft lead (owner: Amit Shah). Redwood support: Ben Carter (solutions engineer) — responsible for connection docs and runbook.
- App integration (call patterns, SDKs): DeltaSoft app team (owner: Claire) — Redwood responsible: Karthik Iyer (account engineer) for sample integration snippets and troubleshooting.
- Security & compliance (PII checks, audit scope): DeltaSoft security (owner: Amit Shah) — Redwood support: Kimberly Park (security lead) for evidence & penetration-scope guidance; Monica Patel (customer success) coordinating evidence requests.
- Procurement & commercial (SLA ask, PO): DeltaSoft procurement (procurement@deltasoft.com) — Redwood contact: me (Rishi) for contract terms and Ben for technical acceptance gating.

Artifacts we'll provide in the kickoff: trial checklist, sample success-criteria spreadsheet, infra playbook (attachment).

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm target kickoff window (we've penciled Sep 12)
2) Delta assigns infra + security leads to this thread (Amit?)
3) Redwood to send checklist & runbook (attached)

Attachments: mvp_success_criteria.xlsx (success metrics), infra_playbook.zip (connectivity checklist), delta_trial_checklist.pdf (kickoff checklist)

If that looks good, I'll loop in Monica to schedule the kickoff and Ben to run pre-POC checks.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Rishi
